content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The District Selection Committee has announced a total of 08 vacancies under AYUSH Public Health Programmes in Hanumakonda District. The post-wise and category-wise breakdown is detailed below:

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

rows.qualification_required: Must possess a Degree in Ayurveda or Unani or Homoeopathy or Naturopathy system awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under Central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government after having undergone a regular course of institutional study in the respective systems, both in theory and practice for a period not less than 4 ½ years duration in a teaching institution recognized by the university or state government with one year compulsory internship.
i) Must possess any of the following qualifications: a. D Pharmacy, b. B Pharmacy, c. Pharma D.ii) Must be registered with the Telangana Pharmacy Council.

rows.post: Psychosocial Counselor (on Call) @ Rs.500/- per session & atleast 200 visits in a year
rows.qualification_required: Must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Master of Social Work (MSW) awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under Central Act or an Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission.

i) Must possess a Degree in Naturopathy system awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government after having undergone a regular course of institutional study in the respective systems , both in theory and practice for a period not less than 4 ½ years duration in a teaching institution recognized by the university or state government with one year compulsory internship.ii) Must possess a ‘Diploma in Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences’ awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under Central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government.
i) Must have passed VII Class examination.ii) Must be able to ride a Bicycle / Motorcycle.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The recruitment is to be made on outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027 and thereafter the services will be as per the need and also subject to satisfactory performance. For Psychosocial Counselor, a panel of eligible candidates may be empaneled. The empaneled candidates shall be engaged on a call basis, as and when their services are required.

rows.consolidated_pay_per_month_in_rs: @ Rs. 500/- per session & atleast 200 visits in a year (on Call)

content_sections.heading: Age Limit and Relaxations
content_sections.text: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years. The minimum and maximum age shall be reckoned as on 01/07/2026.

rows.relaxation: 3 (Three) years in addition to the length of service in armed forces

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selections will be done based on the following criteria: Total Marks are 100 of which 90 marks will be allotted basing on the marks obtained in qualifying examination for AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacists, Dieticians, Psychosocial Counselor and Yoga Professional. For Multi-Purpose-Worker, 90 marks will be allotted for written test conducted by the concerned authorities. For all the posts, (10) marks will be awarded for the age. Weightage for age will be reckoned from 18 years of age of the candidate 0.5 mark will be awarded for one completed year of age with a maximum of 10 marks. The age will be reckoned as on 1.7.2026. Merit list will be prepared based on the marks obtained with above criteria and displayed on website for transparency. Selection list will be prepared from the finalized merit list duly following the rule of reservation and Presidential Order.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Hanumakonda District Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Application forms along with the instructions can be downloaded from official website of Hanumakonda District. Filled in application forms shall be submitted in person or through registered post to O/o: The District Medical & Health Officer, S-16, Second floor, Integrated District Officers Complex (IDOC), Hanumakonda District - 506001. Ensure the application reaches the designated office on or before Dt: 28/10/2026 5:00 pm. The applications, which are received after the due date, will be summarily rejected. District Selection Committee is not responsible for the postal delays.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSC or equivalent examination Intermediate or 10+2 examination Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks memos of all the years (qualifying examination) Registration Certificates of Board of Indian Medicine (for AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification and Medical Officer Posts) Registration Certificate of the Telangana Pharmacy Council (for Pharmacist post) Latest Caste Certificates issued by the Tahsildar / MRO concerned Study Certificate for the years from 4th Class to 10th class and in case of Private Study Residency Certificate from the Tahsildar / MRO concerned PH Certificate in respect of candidates claiming reservation under PH Quota Relevant Certificates in respect of candidates claiming Ex-service man quota 1 Photographs duly pasted on the application form Acknowledgment card

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the due date (Dt: 28/10/2026 5:00 pm) will be summarily rejected. District Selection Committee is not responsible for the postal delays. All the required certificates should be attested by Gazetted Officer and enclosed with the application form. The recruitment is to be made on outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027. For Psychosocial Counselor, the empaneled candidates shall be engaged on a call basis, as and when their services are required.

faq.question: Q1. What is Hanumakonda District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Hanumakonda District Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment notification issued by the Office of the District Collector and Magistrate, Hanumakonda District, to engage various categories of services on outsourcing basis under AYUSH Public Health Programmes in Hanumakonda District up to 31.03.2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 08 vacancies are available across posts including AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacist, Psychosocial Counselor, Yoga Professional, and Multi Purpose Worker (MPW).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled-in application form in person or through registered post is Dt: 28/10/2026 5:00 pm.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for AYUSH Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Must possess a Degree in Ayurveda or Unani or Homoeopathy or Naturopathy system awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under Central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government after having undergone a regular course of institutional study in the respective systems, both in theory and practice for a period not less than 4 ½ years duration in a teaching institution recognized by the university or state government with one year compulsory internship.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Hanumakonda District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years. The minimum and maximum age shall be reckoned as on 01/07/2026 with relaxations for S.C’s, S.T’s & BC’s, Ex-Service man, and Disable persons.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for these vacancies?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted in person or through Registered Post at O/o: The District Medical & Health Officer, S-16, Second floor, Integrated District Officers Complex (IDOC), Hanumakonda District - 506001.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: Total Marks are 100 of which 90 marks will be allotted basing on the marks obtained in qualifying examination (or written test for Multi-Purpose-Worker) and 10 marks will be awarded for the age.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly salary for AYUSH Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay per month for AYUSH Medical Officer is Rs. 40,000/-.

faq.question: Q10. Where should applications be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted at O/o: The District Medical & Health Officer, S-16, Second floor, Integrated District Officers Complex (IDOC), Hanumakonda District - 506001.
